title: Pando: Noise-Coupled Parallel Draft Trees for Efficient Edge Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.32269v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) decoding emits one token per forward pass, reloading the full model each time, so LLM inference on edge devices is memory-bound while the compute units sit idle. Speculative decoding puts that idle compute to work by verifying several drafted tokens in a single pass. State-of-the-art parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark propose an entire block of draft tokens in one forward pass, which makes drafting compute-efficient. However, they are deployed with draft chains whose length is capped by the block size they are trained for, leaving most of the computational budget for verification unused.   To tackle this problem, we propose Pando, which builds dynamic draft trees on top of a parallel drafter and thereby removes this cap. translated_title: Pando：面向高效边缘端推测解码的噪声耦合并行草稿树
translated_abstract: 自回归（AR）解码每次前向传播仅生成一个词元，且每次都需重新加载完整模型，因此大语言模型在边缘设备上的推理受内存带宽限制，而计算单元处于闲置状态。推测解码通过在单次前向传播中验证多个草稿词元，将这些闲置算力利用起来。诸如 DFlash 和 DSpark 等最先进的并行草稿生成器可在一次前向传播中提出一整块草稿词元，使草稿生成在计算上高效。然而，它们部署时的草稿链长度受限于其训练所针对的块大小，导致验证阶段的大部分计算预算未被利用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 Pando，它在并行草稿生成器之上构建动态草稿树，从而消除了这一限制。Pando 采用噪声耦合剪枝技术：在草稿生成之前先抽取目标模型的采样噪声，并在该噪声下对候选分支进行排序，从而使草稿树保留目标模型最可能接受的分支。
tldr: Pando 在并行草稿生成器之上构建动态草稿树，并通过噪声耦合剪枝在草稿生成前依据目标模型的采样噪声对候选分支排序筛选，从而突破固定块大小对草稿链长度的限制，充分利用验证阶段的计算预算，实现高效的边缘端推测解码。
en_tdlr: Pando removes the block-size cap on draft chains by building dynamic draft trees on top of a parallel drafter, using noise-coupled pruning to rank candidate branches under the target model's sampled noise before drafting, thereby fully utilizing the verification compute budget for efficient edge speculative decoding.
